title.narrative: EU-LAC Digital Alliance: Regional Copernicus Centre in Panama (CopLAC)

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is to establish a regional Copernicus strategy including a Copernicus regional centre in Panama to enhance the resilience of the Latin America and Caribbean countries by supporting their spatial data management capacity and strategic use. This objective is responding to the priority area ¿Digital Transformation and Innovation¿ of the Multiannual Indicative Programme for the Americas and the Caribbean.
